name: Puzzles
author: Simon Tatham and contributors; iOS front end by Greg Hewgill
description: 39 logic puzzles (Mines, Net, Solo, Loopy, Bridges, Pattern, Untangle and the rest),
built from source for Scion. Works offline: no account, no network, no ads.
This is not the App Store build: it is built from the upstream iOS port at the commit
in the Source-Code field, with the build changes listed in
changes: Built on Linux with clang and the iPhoneOS 16.5 SDK in place of Xcode; no source file is changed.
Launch Screen.storyboard replaced by an empty UILaunchScreen in Info.plist (ibtool is macOS only).
The asset catalog's app icons copied as loose AppIcon60x60 and AppIcon76x76 files (actool is macOS only).
Bundle identifier com.scion.oss.puzzles, so it never stands in for the author's App Store app.
version.c in place of svnversion.c, which the Xcode project names and the repository does not carry.
